import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).parent
report=root/"matrix"
report.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
order=[(1,"main"),(1,"candidate"),(2,"candidate"),(2,"main"),(3,"main"),(3,"candidate")]
records=[]
for pair,variant in order:
    binary=root/("matrix-main" if variant=="main" else "matrix-after")
    label=f"pair-{pair}-{variant}"
    print(f"starting {label}",flush=True)
    started=time.time()
    stdout=report/(label+".stdout")
    stderr=report/(label+".stderr")
    with stdout.open("w") as out,stderr.open("w") as err:
        child=subprocess.run([str(binary)],stdout=out,stderr=err,env={**os.environ,"TMPDIR":str(root)},check=True)
    data=json.loads(stdout.read_text().removeprefix("concurrent_snapshot_reads "))
    assert not data["smoke"]
    assert data["durability"]=="SyncOnEveryWrite" and data["group_commit"]=="default_disabled"
    assert len(data["cases"])==13
    measured=sum(len(w["requests"]) for c in data["cases"] for w in c["workers"])
    recovered=sum(c["recovered_rows_verified"] for c in data["cases"])
    assert measured==23552 and recovered==216576
    record={"pair":pair,"variant":variant,"elapsed_seconds":time.time()-started,"stdout_sha256":hashlib.sha256(stdout.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"stderr_sha256":hashlib.sha256(stderr.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"timed_requests":measured,"recovered_rows_verified":recovered,"cases":[{k:v for k,v in c.items() if k!="workers"} for c in data["cases"]]}
    records.append(record)
    (report/"summary.json").write_text(json.dumps({"order":order,"runs":records},indent=2)+"\n")
    print(f"completed {label}: {measured} requests and {recovered} recovered rows, {record['elapsed_seconds']:.1f}s",flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,time
root=Path(__file__).parent
fixture=root/'profile-after';fixture.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
with (root/'profile-after.stdout').open('w') as out,(root/'profile-after.stderr').open('w') as err:
 child=subprocess.Popen([str(root/'read-profile-after'),str(fixture)],stdout=out,stderr=err)
 print('profile pid',child.pid,flush=True)
 while not (fixture/'ready').exists():
  assert child.poll() is None;time.sleep(.05)
 (fixture/'start').write_text('start')
 result=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/sample',str(child.pid),'5','1','-mayDie','-file',str(root/'profile-after.sample')],capture_output=True,text=True)
 (root/'sample-after.stdout').write_text(result.stdout);(root/'sample-after.stderr').write_text(result.stderr)
 print('sample exit',result.returncode,flush=True);assert result.returncode==0
 assert child.wait()==0
 print((root/'profile-after.stdout').read_text(),flush=True)
for variant in ['before','after']:
 print('allocation starting',variant,flush=True)
 with (root/f'allocation-{variant}.csv').open('w') as out:
  subprocess.run([str(root/f'allocation-{variant}')],stdout=out,check=True)
 print('allocation completed',variant,flush=True)
print('diagnostics complete',flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,math
root=Path(__file__).parent

def summarize(samples):
 if not samples:return {'count':0}
 s=sorted(samples);n=len(s)
 return {'count':n,'min_nanos':s[0],'p50_nanos':s[(n*50+99)//100-1],'p95_nanos':s[(n*95+99)//100-1],'p99_nanos':s[(n*99+99)//100-1],'max_nanos':s[-1]}

results=[]
for directory in ['matrix']:
 summary=json.loads((root/directory/'summary.json').read_text())
 assert len(summary['runs'])==6
 count=recovered=0
 for run in summary['runs']:
  path=root/directory/f"pair-{run['pair']}-{run['variant']}.stdout"
  assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==run['stdout_sha256']
  report=json.loads(path.read_text().removeprefix('concurrent_snapshot_reads '))
  assert not report['smoke'] and report['durability']=='SyncOnEveryWrite' and report['group_commit']=='default_disabled' and len(report['cases'])==13
  for case in report['cases']:
   reads=[];writes=[];read_intervals=[];writer=None
   assert len(case['workers'])==case['readers']+case['writers']
   for worker in case['workers']:
    assert worker['finished_nanos']>=worker['started_nanos']
    previous=worker['started_nanos']
    for request in worker['requests']:
     start=request['started_nanos'];end=start+request['elapsed_nanos']
     assert start>=previous and end<=worker['finished_nanos']
     previous=end
     (reads if worker['kind']=='read' else writes).append(request['elapsed_nanos'])
     if worker['kind']=='read':read_intervals.append((start,end))
    assert worker['latency']==summarize([r['elapsed_nanos'] for r in worker['requests']])
    if worker['kind']=='write':
     assert writer is None;writer=worker
   assert len(reads)==case['readers']*(512 if case['read_shape']=='point' else 256)
   assert len(writes)==case['writers']*512
   assert case['read_latency']==summarize(reads) and case['write_latency']==summarize(writes)
   elapsed=max(w['finished_nanos'] for w in case['workers'])-min(w['started_nanos'] for w in case['workers'])
   assert case['elapsed_nanos']==elapsed
   assert math.isclose(case['requests_per_second'],(len(reads)+len(writes))*1e9/elapsed,rel_tol=1e-12)
   overlap=0 if writer is None else sum(start>=writer['started_nanos'] and end<=writer['finished_nanos'] for start,end in read_intervals)
   assert case['read_requests_within_writer_phase']==overlap
   assert case['recovered_rows_verified']==16384+len(writes)
   assert case['recovered_commit_epoch']==131+len(writes)
   count+=len(reads)+len(writes);recovered+=case['recovered_rows_verified']
  assert run['cases']==[{k:v for k,v in c.items() if k!='workers'} for c in report['cases']]
 assert count==141312 and recovered==1299456
 results.append({'directory':directory,'processes':6,'cases':78,'requests':count,'recovered_rows':recovered,'quantiles_worker_intervals_overlap_throughput_counts':'pass'})
(root/'independent-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
